kurz: The red pigments in red cabbage, berries and red onions change colour depending on acidity: red when acidic, purple when neutral, blue when alkaline.
bild_im_kopf: Like a natural acid test: red cabbage tells you by its colour how acidic your pot is.
was_passiert: Anthocyanins are pigments that change shape with the [[ph-wert|pH]]. In acidic surroundings they are red, neutral purple, and in alkaline surroundings blue to greenish. Hard, chalky water therefore often turns red cabbage bluish; a splash of vinegar or some apple turns it red again.
warum_wichtig: That is why some German regions call it red cabbage and others blue cabbage. And it is why apple and vinegar belong in the recipe.
faustregeln: For a bright red: add vinegar, wine or apple.
Red berries in batters with baking soda can turn greenish.

praxis.text: Braise red cabbage with apple and vinegar: colour and flavour in one.
Blueberry muffins with a lot of baking soda get greenish spots.
